description: The enterprise multiple compares operating earnings with debt-inclusive value, so it ranks firms with different leverage fairly; cheap firms on it outperform. Fundamentals are point-in-time: only figures filed on or before each rebalance are used. Falsified if it does not beat the equal-weight benchmark after 10 bps costs.
title: Value · EBITDA to enterprise value · top 50 of the Top 500 (after Loughran & Wellman 2011) · long/short
